batch_node.name: grype scan schedule
batch_node.description: Seeds the tap_cares schedule that fires grype:grype daily. See req-grype-trigger in specs/spec-grype-v0.md.

data.cost_per_fire: No credential and no network: a scan reads the grid and the installed database only. One fire runs Grype once per operating system over the packages and libraries on the grid and writes one batch.

node.name: grype scan
node.description: Scans every package and library on the grid with the pinned Grype against the installed advisory database, and writes the run, findings, vulnerabilities and per-target coverage. Runs at 04:43, off the top of the hour and after the 02:17 database refresh. A fire that finds another collection job running is skipped and writes nothing. Disable or re-time this freely; Schedule is user-editable.
